title: Yellowed Rich Tuscan Chicken Pasta
description: A comforting and rich Italian dish featuring chicken, pasta, and a creamy sauce, perfect for a sick day, and can be easily made vegan-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
In a blender or food processor, combine the vegetable broth, coconut milk, nutritional yeast, dried basil, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the blended sauce to the skillet with the chicken and onion, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it has thickened and emulsified.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce and chicken.
Serve the pasta hot, in a Korean brass bowl if desired, and enjoy.
Garnish with additional basil or nutritional yeast if desired.
